Space between tabs, so labels read as separate targets. Not a step on az.spacing: the scale has no 44px step.
Tab top and bottom padding. The same value as az.spacing.2, kept as the component's own value so the tab's height can change without moving the spacing scale.
Tab left and right padding. Not a step on az.spacing: the scale goes 8px then 16px.
A disabled tab has no underline of its own: it can't become the current tab.

Tab label typeface, from the Figma design. Garamond Premier Pro is not in the brand font palette: az.font-family.serif is MiloSerifWeb. Design review needs to confirm the face before an implementation ships it; MiloSerifWeb follows as the fallback so the design system's serif is used where Garamond is unavailable.
Tab label text size. The same value as az.font-size.h3, kept as the component's own value because it is a tab's size, not a heading level.
Tab label line height, as a ratio of the text size. Not az.line-height.base (1.5) or .sm (1.25): the Figma design sets 140%.
The current tab's underline weight, heavier than the rule beneath the row so it reads as selected. Not az.border.width.md (2px), which the rule uses; the border scale has no 4px step.
